assignments.essential_function: Review a proposed code change for weakened safeguards, regressions, affected callers, test gaps and concrete security consequences.

review: Read unchanged SKILL.md plus methodology, adversarial, reporting and patterns references. Provides a structured security change review: inspect baseline/history, analyze removed safeguards, trace callers, examine test gaps, form attack scenarios and write a report with coverage/confidence. Scope is change review, not a proof of security. File-count/risk thresholds and grep-based caller counts are heuristic; Solidity-heavy examples illustrate scenarios rather than validated real vulnerabilities. The source explicitly permits manual context tracing without audit-context-building and using adversarial.md instead of the optional agent; these are upstream-supported paths, not overrides.
native_prerequisites: A local Git repository with accessible base/head refs, file reading/search, Bash/POSIX shell commands and file writing; gh only for PR metadata.
Preserve entire differential-review plugin, including methodology.md, adversarial.md, reporting.md, patterns.md and optional agents.
audit-context-building optional; source documents manual line-by-line fallback.
Namespaced adversarial-modeler agent optional; source offers direct adversarial.md route.
issue-writer is an optional follow-on, not verified or supplied as a required executable.
AutoGPT compatibility with the skill loader and tool interface has not been tested.
